requirement: The system shall process documents stored in Apache Lucene indexes and provide access to analyzer-normalized term data for NLP workflows, remaining compatible with the declared Lucene 5.2.0 dependencies.
Users shall be able to retrieve indexed documents using query and filter criteria, specify the number of results to return, and select sorting criteria.
Users shall be able to generate document vectors from a Lucene index and export them to a LIBSVM-format file for use with external machine learning tools.
The system shall support interactive Scala sessions for ad hoc NLP processing and experimentation, returning results within the interactive session.
Users shall be able to visualize supplied word-count data as charts through the product's experimental chart display capability.

Users shall be able to load schema configuration from a named resource or a file. The configuration shall contain a schema definition with a default analyzer and a non-empty field list and shall support optional custom analyzers. The system shall report an invalid-schema error when the source is unavailable or required schema elements are missing.
